title: Using a stun window instead of winning a fight
target: How to use a stun in R.E.P.O. so the crew gets through a room instead of standing and fighting a monster it had no reason to beat.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A stun item in someone's hands
A monster you have already seen coming
Somewhere you intend to go next

steps.do: Carry something that stuns as well as something that kills.
steps.because: the game ships weapons built specifically to stun (ItemStunBaton)

steps.do: Choose the delivery that fits the room: held, thrown, or left behind.
steps.because: a stun arrives as a baton, a grenade and a mine (ItemGrenadeStun)

steps.do: Move during the stun rather than after it, and treat it as a window.
steps.because: a stunned monster runs on a timer with a defined start and end (EnemyStateStunned)

steps.do: Check what will set a mine off before you leave it behind you.
steps.because: a mine is told whether enemies, players, objects or forces trigger it (triggeredByEnemies)

steps.do: Get the loot out of reach before anyone throws an explosive.
steps.because: the game separates stun mines from explosive and shockwave ones (MineType)

commonMistakes: Killing the monster instead of walking past it while it is down.
Leaving a mine on the route your own crew uses.
Throwing an explosive into a room holding the loot you came for.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
